import.title: Import patient data
import.subtitle: Bulk-upload your existing clinic patients (Excel or CSV)
import.step1: Download the ready template and fill in patient data (or use your existing clinic file with the same columns).
import.step2: Upload the file here — the system generates an automatic file number for each patient and stores your old number as a reference.
import.step3: Siblings sharing the same "family name" are linked automatically, and a guardian is created if provided.
import.columns_note: Upload any sheet — you'll match its columns in the next step. Only name, date of birth and gender are required.
import.bad_format: Unsupported format — use a .xlsx or .csv file
import.empty: The file is empty or has no data rows
import.no_name_column: No name column found — check the header row (use the template)
import.err_dob: Missing or invalid date of birth
import.no_errors: All rows imported successfully with no errors 🎉
import.review_note: Review the data before confirming — nothing is saved until you click "Confirm import".
import.skip_note: Rows with errors will be skipped and not imported. Fix the file and re-upload to include them.
import.session_expired: Preview expired, please upload the file again
import.map_subtitle: match each column to a field
import.map_hint: We auto-matched from your header row — fix anything that's off, and set a field to "Ignore" if your file doesn't have it. Only name, date of birth and gender are required.
import.map_required: Please pick a column for the required fields: name, date of birth, and gender.
import.unreadable: Couldn't read the file — make sure it's a valid Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file.

vaccinations.title: Vaccinations
vaccinations.subtitle: Egyptian schedule + brands + dose tracking
vaccinations.select_patient: Select a patient to view their vaccination schedule

vaccinations.manage_subtitle: Add and edit vaccines, their brands and dose schedules
vaccinations.schedule_help_title: How to enter the dose schedule?
vaccinations.schedule_help: Enter each dose's age in months from birth, comma-separated. Examples: "0, 2, 4, 6" = at birth, then 2, 4, 6 months. For a booster at a specific age add it: "2, 4, 6, 18" (booster at 18 months), or "12, 18" for two doses. For years multiply by 12 (2 years = 24, 4 years = 48).
vaccinations.cannot_delete_used: Cannot delete — used in a patient record
vaccinations.schedules_subtitle: Age-based dosing schedules (A/B/C/D) and catch-up rules.
vaccinations.tpl_help: Keep dosing schedules here (not on the vaccine) so one vaccine can have several — e.g. Schedule A starts at 2 months, Schedule C is a catch-up starting at 12 months.
vaccinations.tpl_no_doses: No doses yet — add the first one below.
vaccinations.verify_invalid_sub: This verification link is not valid.
vaccinations.verify_note: This record is verified directly from the clinic's system via the certificate QR code.
vaccinations.replaced_by_hint: If production stopped, point to the replacement vaccine.
vaccinations.reminders_subtitle: Patients with an overdue or due-soon dose.

vaccinations.no_due: No due dose for this patient.
vaccinations.doses_per_vial_hint: 1 = single-dose ampoule (one per patient). More = a multi-dose vial (e.g. 10 = one vial covers 10 patients).
vaccinations.doctor_fee_hint: Part of the price that goes to the doctor. Clinic margin = price − cost − doctor's fee.
vaccinations.given_outside: Given outside the clinic (gov. unit / elsewhere) — record only, no stock or charge
